profile.name: Caleb Gilbert
profile.biography: An independent filmmaker based in Ōtautahi, NZ. I specialise in narrative, short story films with a dramatic focus.

projects.title: Broken Vessel
projects.description: Feisty teenage girl, Brooklyn emotionally struggles with constant bad decisions, impulsive escapism, and drug use; she makes the decision to change when she realises she is losing the people that really matter.
